summary: Iter26 USD pricing + currency switching tests. Backend 8/8 PASS: catalog accepts/exposes base_5_nights_usd, additional_night_usd, cost_usd, price_usd (lodging/meal_addon/transport/tour); GET /api/event-types exposes _usd fields; POST /api/quotes/calculate with currency='USD' uses *_usd prices (lodging rate_per_person_total = base_5_nights_usd + additional_night_usd*(nights-5); meals from cost_usd; transport/tour from price_usd; categories from fee_usd) and returns 'currency':'USD' in response; currency='COP' (and default) preserves legacy behaviour; POST/GET /api/tournaments persists+returns categories with both fee and fee_usd. Frontend verified: (a) /admin sidebar shows EXACTLY the 20 items in the requested order; (b) /admin/inventario tabs Hospedaje/Alimentación/Transporte/Tours expose USD inputs (inv-lodging-base-usd-*, inv-lodging-add-usd-*, inv-meal_addon-cost-usd-*, inv-price-usd-*); (c) /admin/torneos modal (Nuevo evento) renders category-fee-input-{i} and category-fee-usd-input-{i} after 'Agregar categoría'; (d) /cotizar shows currency-toggle with currency-COP/currency-USD buttons, switching to USD updates total to 'US$...USD' suffix, default cotizar-total shown; (e) /admin/carnets shows the 5 expected filters (carnet-search, carnet-club-filter, carnet-tournament-filter, carnet-category-filter, carnet-team-filter).
critical_code_review_comments: _calc_lodging_block correctly switches between base_5_nights / additional_night and *_usd variants based on currency param; extra-pax billing uses additional_night value in same currency — verified.

_calculate_quote currency-aware: uses _fee_key='fee_usd' for events+categories, _price_field='price_usd' for transport/tour, and cost_usd for meal_addons. Legacy 'per_day_by_tier' (meal_plans matrix) is intentionally skipped in USD mode (only meal_addons supported in USD) — documented behaviour.
Response includes 'currency' field — UI can reflect symbol/suffix correctly.

Tournaments categories is a free-form List[dict], so fee_usd is persisted opaquely without explicit Pydantic validation — adequate for now, but consider typed CategoryFeeIn(BaseModel) to enforce numeric types.
AdminLayout NAV order matches requested order EXACTLY (20 items).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (sidebar order, inventory USD inputs across 4 tabs, tournaments fee_usd input, cotizar currency-toggle with USD total, carnets 5 filters)

seed_data_creation: Tests create+delete TEST_iter26_* catalog rows (lodging/meal_addon/transport/tour) and one TEST_iter26_tournament_* tournament; all cleaned up in teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file is /app/backend/tests/test_iter26_usd_and_currency.py (8 tests, all green). Run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported. For tournaments POST: /api/tournaments requires name, season, category (string, legacy), start_date, end_date — categories list is optional and accepts arbitrary dicts (fee_usd is persisted). For USD quotes: rate_per_person_total = base_5_nights_usd + additional_night_usd*(nights-5); if a USD price is 0 in catalog, that line contributes 0 (no fallback to COP, by design). Frontend tournaments modal: requires clicking 'Agregar categoría' for category-fee-input-{i}/category-fee-usd-input-{i} to render (they are dynamic).
